Messages.Author: Robas
Messages.Body:
Hi ppl!

Just a question about Baltimor Purge, i hope you guys could help me.

- If i call BP with a Lasombra, any Lasobra, do i get to choose all
the Vampires who go into torpor even if they are older? Or do i only
get to choose any Vampire from those yonger the my acting Vampire?

Thank you!

Kind regards from Portugal

Bruno Robalo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Robas wrote:
> Hi ppl!
>
>
> Just a question about Baltimor Purge, i hope you guys could help me.
>
> - If i call BP with a Lasombra, any Lasobra, do i get to choose all
> the Vampires who go into torpor even if they are older? Or do i only
> get to choose any Vampire from those yonger the my acting Vampire?

The vampires chosen must be the same age or younger.

Controlling a Lasombra means you get to choose, not that the restrictions
on which vampires may be chosen changes.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:
> The vampires chosen must be the same age or younger.
>
> Controlling a Lasombra means you get to choose, not that the restrictions
> on which vampires may be chosen changes.

Note also (for the OP) that it's _controlling_ a Lasombra that's
required -- the Lasombra doesn't need to do the BP action itself.

--Colin McGuigan
